name: Otonashi Akari
source:
Mysterious woman whom Kouya encounters during his investigations in the cave. Like all the villagers, she hides the truth about the events from him. 
In fact, she is Touya-sama, the authority whose opinion does not dare to contradict any Magakimura-villager.
